glossary.definition: (1) "Small business enterprise" means any person with a principal place of business or research in the state, who meets the definition of a "small business concern" as defined in 13 C.F.R. 121.7 (a), as amended.
glossary.source_title: Section 122.38 - Small business innovation research grant program.

glossary.definition: (2) "Eligible educational institution" means any educational institution that disseminates information, conducts educational or technical seminars and meetings, or provides other services of value or interest to small business enterprises.
glossary.source_title: Section 122.38 - Small business innovation research grant program.
